columns.name: K

columns.name: Temperature

columns.name: pH

columns.description: Amount of rainfall received

columns.description: Percentage of water content in the soil

columns.description: Type of soil (1 = Sandy, 2 = Loamy, 3 = Clay)

columns.name: Sunlight_Exposure
columns.description: Average daily sunlight exposure

columns.name: Wind_Speed
columns.description: Wind speed at the farm

columns.name: CO2_Concentration
columns.description: Carbon dioxide concentration in the air

columns.name: Organic_Matter
columns.description: Percentage of organic material in the soil

columns.name: Irrigation_Frequency
columns.description: Frequency of irrigation

columns.name: Crop_Density
columns.description: Number of plants per square meter

columns.name: Pest_Pressure
columns.description: Level of pest infestation pressure

columns.name: Fertilizer_Usage
columns.description: Amount of fertilizer applied per hectare

columns.name: Growth_Stage
columns.description: Current growth stage of the crop (1 = Seedling, 2 = Vegetative, 3 = Flowering)

columns.name: Urban_Area_Proximity
columns.description: Distance to the nearest urban area

columns.name: Water_Source_Type
columns.description: Type of water source used for irrigation (1 = River, 2 = Groundwater, 3 = Recycled)

columns.name: Frost_Risk
columns.description: Risk index of frost occurrence

columns.name: Water_Usage_Efficiency
columns.description: Efficiency of water usage per kilogram of crop yield

columns.name: THI
columns.description: Temperature-Humidity Index: evaluations of crop stress due to heat and moisture

columns.name: NBR
columns.description: Nutrient Balance Ratio: balance between nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium in the soil

columns.name: WAI
columns.description: Water Availability Index: composite assessment of soil moisture and rainfall

columns.name: PP
columns.description: Photosynthesis Potential: estimate based on sunlight exposure, CO2, and temperature

columns.name: SFI
columns.description: Soil Fertility Index: composite fertility based on organic matter and NPK levels
